input.quote: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Section 20 satisfies the preferred position, so no redline is needed. Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates for third-party claims that the Services or Deliverables infringe IP (20.1), and for Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud (20.2). Prompt notice, control of the defence and reasonable cooperation are allocated in 20.4, and Customer's indemnity is narrow, limited to unmodified Customer-supplied material and Customer's violation of Applicable Law (20.3). Section 20.5 adds procure, modify, replace and refund remedies, and 21.3 makes indemnification obligations Excluded Claims so the indemnity is not compressed by the liability cap; the fallback three-times-fees super-cap would be less favourable to us and is not sought.
